a01990428.definition: having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand
examples: a list of articles pertinent to the discussion
remarks that were to the point

a01990694.definition: having no bearing on or connection with the subject at issue

examples: a digressive allusion to the day of the week

a01991142.definition: not pertinent to the matter under consideration
examples: an issue extraneous to the debate
mentioned several impertinent facts before finally coming to the point

a01991635.definition: of no legal significance (as having been previously decided)

a01992297.definition: serving to bring to mind; "cannot forbear to close on this redolent literary note" - Wilder Hobson
examples: a campaign redolent of machine politics

a01992903.definition: suffering from a partial loss of memory

a01994168.definition: of visual imagery of almost photographic accuracy

a01994471.definition: characterized by or of the nature of or using mimesis

a01995225.definition: not representing or imitating external reality or the objects of nature

a01995464.definition: represented in simplified or symbolic form
